title: Fenari İsa Mosque

buildingCutout.basis: Named mosque envelope from OpenStreetMap way 329095050.

terrainReference.basis: Approximate local paving just beyond the southwest wall.

mapIdentity.provider: Native OpenStreetMap mosque footprint and boulevard reference. The church volumes and eastern apses follow published architectural descriptions.
mapIdentity.scope: The named 25.24 m by 29.62 m native envelope and signed boulevard frontage fix the complex. Published architectural descriptions distinguish the paired churches and their shared western narthex and eastern apses.

note: The cleared 2020 boulevard photo constrains the brick and stone front, rhythm of six grilled windows, taller windowed drum, smaller caps and slender later minaret. Undocumented mass offsets, heights and minor apses are reconstructed estimates.
